correction: The focused fixture uses real core mouse User32 delivery to prove actual subclass procedure entry/return/capture and detachment. It exercises the same production bounded touch/pointer scalar encoder with deterministic API results, including unavailable results. It does not claim generated hardware touch delivery; real touchscreen delivery remains operator-supplied evidence.
